3.0 Emergency Procedures By Type

3.1 FIRE EMERGENCY

☐ R.A.C.E. Protocol:

- RESCUE anyone in immediate danger

- ALARM: Pull nearest fire alarm, call 911

- CONTAIN: Close doors and windows

- EXTINGUISH: Use appropriate extinguisher OR EVACUATE

☐ P.A.S.S. Extinguisher Operation:

- PULL the pin

- AIM at base of fire

- SQUEEZE the handle

- SWEEP side to side

☐ Evacuation Assembly Point: ______________

☐ Fire Extinguisher Locations: ______________

3.2 MEDICAL EMERGENCY

☐ Assess the situation - ensure scene safety

☐ Call 911 immediately for life-threatening conditions

☐ Provide first aid/CPR if trained

☐ Do not move victim unless immediate danger exists

☐ Send someone to meet ambulance

☐ Document incident for insurance/legal purposes

FIRST AID KIT LOCATIONS: ______________

AED LOCATIONS: ______________

CERTIFIED FIRST AID PROVIDERS: ______________

3.3 CHEMICAL SPILL / RELEASE

☐ MINOR SPILL (trained personnel only):

- Notify supervisor and area personnel

- Don appropriate PPE (gloves, goggles, apron)

- Use spill kit to contain and absorb

- Dispose of waste properly

☐ MAJOR SPILL / RELEASE:

- EVACUATE area immediately

- CALL 911 and Environmental Agency

- Isolate area, deny entry

- Shut off ignition sources

- Only trained responders in proper PPE to contain

SPILL KIT LOCATIONS: ______________

MSDS/SDS LOCATIONS: ______________

3.4 NATURAL DISASTER

☐ TORNADO:

- Move to designated shelter area: ______________

- Stay away from windows

- Crouch low, cover head

☐ EARTHQUAKE:

- DROP to ground

- COVER under sturdy furniture

- HOLD ON until shaking stops

☐ FLOOD:

- Move to higher ground

- Do not drive through flooded areas

- Follow evacuation orders

3.5 ACTIVE SHOOTER / WORKPLACE VIOLENCE

☐ RUN:

- Have escape route planned

- Leave belongings behind

- Help others escape

☐ HIDE:

- Hide in area out of shooter's view

- Lock doors, barricade with heavy objects

- Silence cell phones, turn off lights

☐ FIGHT (last resort):

- Act with physical aggression

- Improvise weapons

- Commit to your actions
